intro: UAE / Dubai cybersecurity job sources. English is the working language across tech + cyber roles. Employer sponsors work visa (mandatory). Tax-free salaries in AED. Target roles: Associate Security Engineer, AppSec, Product Security, Security Analyst.

live_boards.name: LinkedIn UAE — Application Security Engineer (last 24h)
live_boards.notes: Freshest listings. Enable email alert for daily digest. Highest-volume single source for tech roles in UAE.

live_boards.name: LinkedIn UAE — Product Security Engineer
live_boards.notes: Smaller pool than AppSec — weekly cadence appropriate. Product-side roles concentrated in Dubai + Abu Dhabi.

live_boards.name: LinkedIn UAE — Security Analyst (entry/associate)
live_boards.notes: Entry + associate experience filter (f_E=2,3). Government + banking heavy hirers here.

live_boards.name: LinkedIn UAE — Associate Security Engineer
live_boards.notes: Direct match for your target role title. Refresh 2-3x per week.

live_boards.name: Bayt.com — Cybersecurity UAE
live_boards.notes: Largest MENA job board. Government + banking + oil-and-gas heavily post here. Complete Bayt profile — recruiters search it.

live_boards.name: Naukrigulf.com — Security UAE
live_boards.notes: Naukri's Gulf edition. Familiar interface if you already have a Naukri India profile. Popular with Indian recruiters placing in UAE.

live_boards.name: GulfTalent — Cybersecurity
live_boards.notes: Premium regional board. Strong for mid-senior roles at multinationals + FS. Set up job alerts.

live_boards.name: Indeed UAE — Cybersecurity (fresh 3 days)
live_boards.notes: Cross-aggregator. Complements LinkedIn + Bayt. Fresh-only filter to keep signal high.

live_boards.name: Hays Middle East — Technology
live_boards.notes: UK staffing giant with major UAE presence. Contract + perm tech roles. Sponsor-aware.

live_boards.name: Michael Page UAE — Cybersecurity
live_boards.notes: Global staffing firm. Strong for financial services cyber roles in DIFC + ADGM.

live_boards.name: Cooper Fitch — Technology UAE
live_boards.notes: Regional executive-search + recruitment firm. Higher-quality mid-senior placements. Good for Big-4 cyber advisory routing.

live_boards.name: Robert Walters UAE
live_boards.notes: Global staffing firm with UAE office. Mid-senior tech + cyber. Sponsor-aware.

live_boards.name: Charterhouse UAE — Technology
live_boards.notes: Regional professional services recruitment. Good for banking + FS cyber roles.

live_boards.name: Wellfound — Dubai Security
live_boards.notes: Startup-heavy. Smaller pool than mainstream boards but direct-founder access on smaller companies. Careem-adjacent tech scene.

live_boards.name: Welcome to the Jungle — UAE
live_boards.notes: Modern startup-focused board. English-first. Good for scale-ups.

target_companies.name: Help AG (part of e& Enterprise)
target_companies.notes: Largest pure-play cybersecurity firm in the Middle East. Owned by Etisalat's e& Enterprise. Strong MSSP + consulting practice. Sponsors visa. Structured entry-level pathway via SOC.

target_companies.name: CPX (part of G42)
target_companies.notes: Part of G42 group. Focuses on advanced cybersecurity for government + enterprise. Well-funded, growing fast.

target_companies.name: Injazat (part of G42)
target_companies.notes: IBM-Injazat JV originally; now G42-owned. Managed IT + security services for UAE government + enterprise.

target_companies.name: e& Enterprise (Etisalat)
target_companies.notes: Etisalat's enterprise arm. Large managed security services practice. Overlap with your telecom background from Cubic.

target_companies.name: du (EITC)
target_companies.notes: Second UAE telco. In-house SOC + cyber team. Direct telecom overlap.

target_companies.name: Emirates NBD
target_companies.notes: UAE's largest bank. Well-established cyber team. Regulated by CBUAE — DORA-equivalent oversight.

target_companies.name: ADCB (Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank)
target_companies.notes: Major UAE bank. Cybersecurity team hires steadily. Financial regulatory context useful for GRC track.

target_companies.name: First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB)
target_companies.notes: UAE's largest bank by assets. Substantial cyber team + threat intel practice.

target_companies.name: Mashreq Bank
target_companies.notes: Progressive UAE bank with digital-first strategy. Strong cybersecurity + fraud teams.

target_companies.name: Emirates Group / dnata
target_companies.notes: Emirates Airline + dnata. Substantial IT + cyber team. Non-EU workforce common; strong sponsor track record.

target_companies.name: Careem (Uber subsidiary)
target_companies.notes: Middle East super-app. English working language. Product security team hires actively. Uber-adjacent processes.

target_companies.name: Noon.com
target_companies.notes: Regional e-commerce leader. English working language. Fintech + payments + logistics attack surface.

target_companies.name: Talabat (Delivery Hero)
target_companies.notes: Delivery Hero's MENA arm. Berlin engineering culture, English-language. Sponsor-aware.

target_companies.name: Microsoft UAE
target_companies.notes: Microsoft Security specialist team + consulting. Standard sponsor pipeline.

target_companies.name: AWS UAE
target_companies.notes: AWS ME region. Security engineering + consulting roles.

target_companies.name: Google UAE
target_companies.notes: Smaller Dubai office. Sales engineering + customer-facing security roles most common. Sponsors.

target_companies.name: Oracle UAE
target_companies.notes: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure + consulting practice. Sponsor UAE work visa.

target_companies.name: Cisco UAE
target_companies.notes: Regional HQ. Security-focused pre-sales + consulting. Sponsor.

target_companies.name: CrowdStrike UAE
target_companies.notes: Falcon platform + Overwatch SOC coverage. Regional presence growing.

target_companies.name: Palo Alto Networks UAE
target_companies.notes: Regional presence. Consulting + pre-sales focus for UAE.

target_companies.name: Mandiant (Google Cloud) UAE
target_companies.notes: IR + threat intel for the region. Part of Google Cloud Security. Strong brand for the CV.

target_companies.name: KPMG UAE — Cyber
target_companies.notes: Cyber Risk practice. Structured lateral hiring at associate + senior associate. Sponsor UAE work visa.

target_companies.name: Deloitte Middle East — Cyber Risk
target_companies.notes: Cyber & Strategic Risk practice active in ME. Regulatory work (NESA, ADSIC, DIFC) — good for GRC pivot.

target_companies.name: EY Middle East — Cybersecurity
target_companies.notes: Cyber + Privacy practice. Sponsors. Regional client base includes government + banking.

target_companies.name: PwC Middle East — Cyber & Privacy
target_companies.notes: Cyber + Privacy consulting. Structured associate → senior associate pathway.

target_companies.name: Accenture Middle East — Security
target_companies.notes: Large regional security practice. Sponsors UAE work visa. Entry via consulting track.

target_companies.name: Spire Solutions
target_companies.notes: MENA cybersecurity distributor. Vendor-side pre-sales + technical roles. Good pivot into vendor careers.

target_companies.name: StarLink (Infinigate)
target_companies.notes: Large regional value-added distributor for security vendors. Pre-sales + technical enablement roles.

target_companies.name: Paramount Computer Systems
target_companies.notes: MENA cybersecurity services firm. Consulting + MSSP + GRC. Sponsor-aware.

target_companies.name: Mubadala Investment Company
target_companies.notes: Abu Dhabi sovereign wealth fund with in-house cyber team. High-prestige employer. Sponsor UAE visa.

target_companies.name: ADNOC
target_companies.notes: State oil company. Growing OT + IT security team. Regulatory context: NESA, critical infrastructure. Sponsor.

target_companies.name: Chalhoub Group
target_companies.notes: Luxury retail group with substantial IT + cyber footprint. Progressive employer, English-first.
